claims.claim: Q2 revenue rose 8.6% to $268.5M; GAAP operating margin improved to 4.6% from -3.0%, while Tenable added 381 enterprise platform customers and 32 net new six-figure customers.

risks: revenue growth remains moderate relative to platform narrative
cybersecurity competition can pressure retention and pricing
AI-native product claims require customer-level proof beyond launches
contradictions: Profitability expanded sharply while top-line growth remained single digit, suggesting efficiency is improving faster than demand growth.
unknowns: net retention and platform expansion rate
share of new enterprise wins attributable specifically to AI-native capabilities

recommendation.reason: Primary current results provide platform adoption and operating-leverage evidence for underwriting.
